focal_entities.audience: whoever makes a license work in this repository and whoever judges it

goal_orientation.purpose: making and judging each license work

constraints.decision: Scope: The license checklist serves a LICENSE file of any licence, not MIT alone: whoever reads it learns the exact terms under which they may use, copy, change and share the work, from the licence's standard text unchanged, a copyright line with year and holder, and the same licence the README names.

constraints.chosen: usability.md is given to whoever uses the checklist: F-3 of checklist.md judges the checklist against usability.md's current version, which a judge without the file cannot answer
